# Labelarium

> Labelarium is a free, unofficial companion for label makers (Brother P-touch, DYMO, NIIMBOT, Brady, Phomemo). For each model it documents every built-in symbol, frame and template with pictures and the exact key presses, plus step-by-step how-to guides, keyboard maps, shortcuts, specs, and every LCD error message with its cause and fix. It works offline as an installable web app. Not affiliated with any manufacturer.

The full text of every guide and error message is in [llms-full.txt](https://labelarium.com/llms-full.txt).

## Label makers
- [Brother P-touch PT-D220](https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220): Home & Office Everyday Label Maker. 649 symbols in 30 categories, 100 frames, 25 templates, 14 fonts, 11 styles, 22 shortcuts, 25 how-to guides.
- [Brother P-touch PT-D210](https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210): Easy-to-Use Label Maker. 621 symbols in 27 categories, 99 frames, 27 templates, 14 fonts, 10 styles, 22 shortcuts, 25 how-to guides.
- [Brother P-touch PT-D610BT](https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt): Professional Label Maker with Bluetooth. 900 symbols in 26 categories, 167 frames, 80 templates, 17 fonts, 17 styles, 22 shortcuts, 29 how-to guides.
- [NIIMBOT D110](https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110): Smart Label Printer (US SKU D110_M). 17 symbols in 6 categories, 5 shortcuts, 8 how-to guides.
- [Phomemo M110](https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110): Bluetooth Portable Thermal Business Label Maker. 8 shortcuts, 9 how-to guides.
- [Brother P-touch CUBE Plus PT-P710BT](https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt): Bluetooth cube printer for phones and P-touch Editor. 36 symbols in 6 categories, 3 styles, 17 shortcuts, 15 how-to guides.
- [DYMO LabelManager 160](https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160): Portable Label Maker. 228 symbols in 2 categories, 5 frames, Default typeface, 4 styles, 15 shortcuts, 16 how-to guides.
- [DYMO LabelManager 280](https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280): Rechargeable Portable Label Maker. 221 symbols in 2 categories, 8 frames, 3 fonts, 7 styles, 17 shortcuts, 20 how-to guides.
- [Brady M210](https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210): Portable Industrial Label Printer. 221 symbols in 9 categories, 11 templates, Brady Fixed Width Condensed typeface, 2 styles, 22 shortcuts, 15 how-to guides.
- [Brady M211 Label Printer](https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211): Bluetooth portable printer · Express Labels app. 22 symbols in 4 categories, 10 shortcuts, 11 how-to guides.
